name: macos-permissions
description: >- Diagnoses macOS TCC permission dialogs and silent denials: Screen Recording, Microphone, Camera, Accessibility, Automation, Full Disk Access. Use when a dialog reappears after Allow, a LaunchAgent/`uv run` job keeps prompting, a grant breaks after an update, or to find who is really requesting it (权限弹窗 / 授权了没用 / 完全磁盘访问). Not for launchd design (use macos-watchdog) or app permission UX (use developing-ios-apps).
author: daymade
